summary:
Turn 52 reviewed the second durability defect's check, whose outcome is violated.

State on entry. Claim C9-durable-recorder-uses-the-instance-row has one artifact, c42c67480b344bf5aed734776a77ab37 (executed as f7a553d1…), with outcome violated and oracle correspondence unreviewed. Its retained stream reports durable_phase1_result with panicked true, the nil-pointer panic value, owner_record_written true and own_row_record_written false. Claim C8 (the executor timeout enqueue) was settled this cycle as a bounded no-violation protection.

Review judgement (checker_correspondence, no_issue_found). Requirement versus predicate: the claim is that the metadata recorder receives the record of the instance being written and must not dereference a record the replica does not hold, and the predicate asserts panicked == false; the run reports true, so the assertion is evaluated on printed fields, and the row flags localise the failure to the recording call rather than the instance setup. Entry and legality: the call is the one the prepare resolution makes when it restarts phase 1 with a recovered command (sub-cases 5 and 6), the empty own row is the state of a replica that has not held that instance (a restarted replica), and recording is enabled through the constructor's durable flag, so no protocol code was altered. Oracle and identity: panicked and the row flags are read after the call and the prerequisite and result events share instance 1.0. Bounded consequences and counterevidence: the shipped run.go passes durable=false, so the path is inert in the default deployment; only the nil case is exercised, leaving the slot-exists case — where the source implies another instance's metadata would be recorded — as an explicit unknown; and the panic is observed by the harness while the process-death step follows from the run loop having no recover, as in the earlier crash review. The claim is kept separate from C2, which concerns the layout of the record the recorder writes; here the complaint is which instance's record is recorded at all.

Frontier. Nine claims are settled this cycle (seven confirmed violations or consequences, two bounded no-violation protections), the two paused candidates keep their resume conditions, and the only visible administrative item remains the scope issue on the superseded C1 artifact. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
